title: Remove claim, review path and trailer-wording frictions in the lead loop
body:
Outcome: three small lead-loop frictions from PR #164 are gone.
1) krn task claim run from the main checkout refuses a task whose record is untracked there ('task does not exist', exit 65) though the worktree commits it; accept --worktree's record or say so (relates to t-aw1vr9w).
2) krn review --repo refuses a relative path (exit 64); resolve it like other krn commands.
3) krn-lead skill trap says tracker-only PRs use 'Change-contract: none (<reason>)'; at commit level preflight rejects it (src/flow/repository.ts:603 expects <test>:red->green|green->green) and tracker commits carry no Change-contract. State the per-commit form.
Proof: one observer per item, red at base.

PR #179 (t-jgtaex2): the lead wrote 'Change-contract: <observer path>' without ':red->green' and lost one verify round to the preflight error 'invalid or duplicate Change-contract'. State the per-commit form '<path>:red->green' in the krn-lead Trailer block trap.
